title: Fastpass Portal Hero — animated map + step-lattice for incremental onboarding flows (mobile-first)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Deliver a compact, mobile-first hero module for the Quickstart landing that communicates a three-step Fastpass onboarding flow. The hero combines an animated map metaphor with a lattice of collapsible step cards. Focus goals: reduce cognitive load for first-time users, highlight one-click sample integrations, and provide accessible motion and keyboard navigation. This ticket covers visual design, motion spec, responsive breakpoints, and export-ready assets for engineering handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Hero comp designed for 320–1280px with three responsive breakpoints
Figma file includes auto-layout variants for collapsed/expanded step cards and a documented motion spec (duration, easing, reduced-motion alternate)
Exported PNG/SVGs and vector Lottie JSON for the map animation are linked in attachments
Design tokens mapped to Redwood theme (spacing, colors, type) and accessibility color-contrast verified
Handoff notes include ARIA suggestions and keyboard focus order for the step-lattice
Engineering PR created referencing this ticket and design links

design_review_notes: Keep map motif symbolic (no real geography) to avoid region bias and reduce asset size
Card lattice should support progressive disclosure: collapsed state shows title + one-line summary + CTA; expanded shows two screenshots and a code snippet toggle
Motion: use 240ms for card expand/collapse, 600ms gentle float for map nodes; define cubic-bezier easing and provide reduced-motion at 0ms/opacity-only
Accessibility: ensure all interactive elements have >=4.5:1 contrast against background; include aria-expanded on cards and logical tab order
Performance trade-off: prefer Lottie with compressed JSON over SVG animation to reduce paint overhead on mobile; provide static SVG fallback for no-JS environments
